name: Resource family accepted with an S3 object attached-resource context
note: IAM-1202: family=resource plus the explicit attached-resource context (an S3 object ARN) is ACCEPTED and routed to the resource evaluator, never the identity rules. Principal '*' on the Allow is anonymous/public, so a PUBLIC-ACCESS (critical) finding fires from the RESOURCE's perspective, and the graph draws an anonymous ExternalPrincipal -> can-access-resource -> attached-resource edge. Coverage stays INCOMPLETE (RESOURCE_ANALYSIS_INCOMPLETE): the remaining resource families (confused-deputy, same-account, KMS, NotPrincipal) are IAM-1203..1206. The identity WILDCARD/DATA-EXFIL findings that would fire if this were mis-analyzed as an identity policy must NOT appear.
